name: Coyote Brush
desc: Coyote Brush (Baccharis pilularis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 714 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Baccharis pilularis, called coyote brush (or bush), chaparral broom, and bush baccharis, is an evergreen shrub in the family Asteraceae native to California, Oregon, Washington, and Baja California.
